diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 2.5 V, datasheet reading 3.3 V
diffs.evidence: AHT30 datasheet Table 2 (电气特性/Electrical characteristics): 供电电压 (supply voltage) min 2.2 V, typ 3.3 V, max 5.5 V; feature list: '宽电压支持2.2-5.5 VDC'; application note: '主机MCU给传感器供电电压范围为2.2~5.5V'. 3.3 V is the TYPICAL value, not the minimum, so the second reading misread the table. The model's 2.5 V module minimum is the chip's 2.2 V minimum plus headroom for the module's 662K 3.3 V LDO dropout, i.e. consistent with (and more conservative than) the datasheet.
